gpu_accounting_policy: Count one allocated hour on any allowed GPU as one hour of the shared 24-hour cap; this is wall-time accounting, not A100-equivalent work or billing.
control_gate: At least one native Accepted PDB with a matching final_design_stats row and passing basic geometry; no accepted control is inconclusive and blocks MERTK release.
stopping_policy: Scheduler walltime takes precedence over attempt goals. MERTK final_designs is deliberately above the maximum possible variants, so a planned batch does not stop at the old four-design target. Report interruptions and actual counts.
nomination_policy: Up to six independent MERTK trajectories after default BindCraft filters, intact-context/glycan review and separate three-seed AF3 assessment. No AF3 job without reviewed candidates.
